title: Jesus Paid It All
description: Jesus Paid It All in Tonic Solfa to ALL TO CHRIST: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the six verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Elvina M. Hall wrote the words; the tune ALL TO CHRIST is by John T. Grape (1868).
underlay: I hear the Sa-viour say, “Thy strength in-deed is_ small; Child of weak-ness, watch and pray, Find in Me thine all in all.” Je-sus paid it all, All to Him I owe; Sin had left a crim-son stain, He washed it white as snow.

lines: Child of weakness, watch and pray,
Find in Me thine all in all.”

verses.label: Refrain
lines: Sin had left a crimson stain,
He washed it white as snow.
In the blood of Calv’ry’s Lamb.
And melt the heart of stone.
